class.name: OcgBrepbuilderapiFindplane
class.brief_description: Describes functions to find the plane in which the edges of a given shape are located. A FindPlane object provides a framework for: - extracting the edges of a given shape, - implementing the construction algorithm, and - consulting the result.
class.description: ! Describes functions to find the plane in which the edges ! of a given shape are located. ! A FindPlane object provides a framework for: ! - extracting the edges of a given shape, ! - implementing the construction algorithm, and ! - consulting the result.

method.name: default
method.description: Initializes an empty algorithm. The function Init is then used to define the shape.

method.name: from_2
method.description: Constructs the plane containing the edges of the shape S. A plane is built only if all the edges are within a distance of less than or equal to tolerance from a planar surface. This tolerance value is equal to the larger of the following two values: - Tol, where the default value is negative, or - the largest of the tolerance values assigned to the individual edges of S. Use the function Found to verify that a plane is built. The resulting plane is then retrieved using the function Plane.

method.name: Init
method.description: Constructs the plane containing the edges of the shape S. A plane is built only if all the edges are within a distance of less than or equal to tolerance from a planar surface. This tolerance value is equal to the larger of the following two values: - Tol, where the default value is negative, or - the largest of the tolerance values assigned to the individual edges of S. Use the function Found to verify that a plane is built. The resulting plane is then retrieved using the function Plane.

method.name: Found
method.description: Returns true if a plane containing the edges of the shape is found and built. Use the function Plane to consult the result.
